# Linden Lane Dental

Address: 14 Linden Lane, Harrowgate. Second floor, entrance from the courtyard.

Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8:00–18:00, Saturday 9:00–13:00, closed on Sunday.

Reception phone is on the clinic website; booking is also possible through the online form.
